main_text.p: rifimus ergo ille virtutis, quâ fanguisef-fufus pollet, ipfi medio univerfali, feu animæ mundi, imprimitur; atqui hæc à corporea mole libera, omnia replet & illu-ftrat, loci nihil occupans, ut fuperius di-dicimus; adeoque tota in toto eft, & tota ubivis: characteristico ergo propriæ virtutis ab effufo fanguine, vel pure, impreffo ipfi univerfali medio, feu mundi animæ, quæ in mundo toto eft, nihil loci occupans, facillimo negotio ab extremo terrarum orbis uno ad alterum, intra temporis momentum fympatheticæ curationis vis & energia pertingit; quin imo haud difficiliori negotio pertingeret ad orbem Lunæ ipfamque fupremam fixarum ftellatum fphæram, ubi nempe eadem mundi anima, quæ tota in toto eft, ex æquo tota præfens eft, eundem virtutis characteristicum excipiens. I nunc quicunque dubitas de fympathetica curatione, ad 600. vel 1000. forfan milliarium intervallum fe extendente;

page.notes: Signature "K 3" at foot left; catchword "atque" at foot right. Some words are doubtful in the scan (e.g. "characteristico" read as "characterisimo"; "haud difficiliori" region is blurred); transcription of the Greek-free Latin is as read. Running head and page number are partly faint.
